approach: Matching decompilation of the Allegrex (MIPS32r2) executable of Daxter for PSP: authored C/C++ that builds to a byte-identical copy of the retail executable.
notes: Early stage. The disc is measured and its four container formats are read (PARAM.SFO, ~PSP, PSAR, Pack); the 342 asset containers are inventoried; the game code is a single monolithic executable behind the ~PSP encryption, not a loader plus level overlays as on PlayStation 2. No function has been matched yet.
